item.title: Finding the joy: Inside Bethlehem girls' soccer's turnaround heading into Class AA final
item.description: Bethlehem junior Alexandra Young dribbles the ball in front of Mohonasen junior Gianna Pfister during the Section 2, Class AA semifinals on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026, in Stillwater, NY. (Jim Franco/Times Union) (Jim Franco/Times Union) The Bethlehem girls' soccer team's season ended last fall with a 5-10-1 record and a 3-2 quarterfinal loss to Ballston Spa. On Tuesday, No. 2 Bethlehem (10-4-3) will face No. 5 Ballston Spa (9-5-4) again. This time, it's for the Section 2 Class AA championship at 7:30 p.m. at Shaker High School. Under first-year coach Scott Geis, the Eagles have doubled their win total while embracing an approach built on unity, confidence and joy. Players credit that environment with helping them reach the final, where they'll arrive after a 2-0 semifinal win over Mohonasen on Friday. Junior June McCarthy, who scored a hat trick in the Eagles' 5-0 quarterfinal win over Queensbury last week, recalled last season's difficulties. "When we lost in sectionals, we were all fearful," McCarthy said after Friday's win. "And, today, we definitely had a different approach, and it was a lot more fun - and I want to keep on going with this energy." Geis, a Delmar native who previously played and coached at Siena, moved up from JV to become varsity coach before this season. He wanted to make soccer less about pressure and more about enjoying the game and supporting one another. He brings motivational quotes on poster boards to practices and encourages players to try, fail and trust teammates to step in for one another. "This should be their escape," Geis said. "This should be their joy, their true passion. As soon as you step onto this field, it's a home. We take care of each other." "I think we definitely had a mindset change," said sophomore Maira Braddock, who scored both goals in the semifinal win over Mohonasen. "I think we realized that we can really win this, and our coaching is just amazing, and it's just all the positivity out there." Bethlehem improved from 11th in the Suburban Council with a 3-10-1 league record last season to third at 6-2-2 this fall. The Eagles beat Class AAA teams Shaker and Saratoga Springs, beat defending Class AA champion Niskayuna and tied Class AA top seed Columbia during the regular season. "You can see it out there. We have so much joy," Braddock said. "We all love each other and we all push for each other. I don't think we'd be where we are today if we didn't have the love for each other and the love for the game." The Eagles also learned from their losses. In a 4-2 defeat to Mohonasen in the regular-season finale, sisters Ella and Maggie Mullin combined for three goals and two assists. In Friday's semifinal, Bethlehem pressured the sisters and held Mohonasen scoreless. "I love failure," Geis said. "Failure means you get to learn from it. Failure means you're trying." item.description: Free agent pitcher Tarik Skubal Tarik Skubal is the best player available in free agency this offseason, and he is expected to sign a record-breaking contract. Skubal could be the big domino to fall this offseason, as many big-market teams will be pursuing him. After he signs, the teams that miss out on him could start focusing their resources on other pitchers and really let the pitching market start to move. With a lockout very likely this offseason, players could sign sooner than usual. According to ESPN's Jeff Passan , Skubal is expected to sign before the Dec. 1 lockout. Skubal will want to secure a record-breaking deal before the new CBA potentially interferes with how teams spend their money. However, guys like Freddy Peralta and Michael King may have to wait for Skubal to sign. They will surely have offers on the table, but big-market teams who miss out on Skubal may not be able to present their best offer until Skubal decides where he wants to play. item.description: COLUMBIA, SOUTH CAROLINA - FEBRUARY 22: Head coach Yolett McPhee-McCuin of the Ole Miss Rebels communicates with players during the fourth quarter of an NCAA women's basketball game against the South Carolina Gamecocks at Colonial Life Arena on February 22, 2026 in Columbia, South Carolina. (Photo by Sean Rayford/Getty Images) | Getty Images The top 25 Ole Miss women’s basketball team showed exactly why they have so much hype going into this upcoming season with an 80-38 win over Alcorn St. on Monday. The season opener gave the No. 19 Lady Rebels (1-0) a chance to play someone other than themselves as the team looks to get back to the NCAA Tournament. This was also the annual Kids Day game, so the screaming, hootin’ and hollerin’ of the local school children was constant throughout the broadcast. Jaida Civil led the team in scoring with 17 points while also chipping in six rebounds and five assists. Jade Tillman and Jada Richard also scored in double digits with 14 points each. item.title: Kings rumors: Domantas Sabonis trade talk should surprise absolutely nobody as frustrations mount
item.description: Dennis Lee-Imagn Images Kings rumors: Domantas Sabonis trade talk should surprise absolutely nobody as frustrations mount appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Sacramento Kings have endured a difficult start to the season and are yet to win after six games in the regular season. Their latest loss, a 136-105 blowout against the Memphis Grizzlies, has once again ignited potential trade talks for star man Domantas Sabonis . Speaking to Tim Bontemps on The Hoop Collective, Brian Windhorst talked about the fact that Darius Acuff Jr. was once again the star man for the Kings, scoring 38 points on 25 attempts, while Sabonis, who finished with 11 points and 14 rebounds, only had five attempts in the game. Bontemps then revealed that Sabonis wants to leave, and the Kings would have obliged already if they had the option , per a post on X by ClutchPoints. Domantas Sabonis is unhappy and wants out of Sacramento, per @BannedMacMahon Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “Quite frankly, Sabonis wants out of there, and if they can move him, they would. So he's not happy.” pic.twitter.com/YqLwiU5jAf — NBABase (@TheNBABase) November 2, 2026 “Quite frankly, Sabonis wants out of there, and if they can move him, they would,” he said. “So he’s not happy, it is a bad situation.” Windhorst talked about Sacramento’s poor start to the season, and claimed that any trade would still need to “make sense” for the franchise. That means that Sacramento are obviously looking to get good value in exchange for the 30-year-old who commands a yearly salary of more than $45 million and is under contract until the end of the 2027-28 campaign. Sabonis saw his 2025-26 season end early due to a knee injury, during which he only played 19 games, averaging 15.8 points, 11.4 rebounds, and 4.1 assists. This campaign, Sabonis has thus far averaged 16 points, 15.8 rebounds, and 7.3 assists per game. Regardless, Sabonis has been Sacramento’s main man for the majority of the time he has spent with the team. The fact that his importance has dwindled despite the fact that the Kings are not winning games is bound to frustrate the big man. However, it remains to be seen when, and what kind of value the Kings can get in exchange of the Lithuanian international. For the time being, he will look to return to form in order to attract interest from NBA teams. item.title: It seems that Enzo Maresca keeps getting one Manchester City midfield decision wrong
item.description: It seems that Enzo Maresca keeps getting one Manchester City midfield decision wrong Enzo Maresca got his man when Manchester City signed Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea on the deadline day of the summer transfer window. Maresca was eager to bring the Argentinian midfielder to the Etihad given the close relationship the pair formed when working together at Chelsea. Enzo Fernandez has made a strong impression during his time at City. However, on other occasions it isn’t clear what role in the City midfield Enzo Fernandez is tasked with playing. When Manchester City were in the midst of a seven-match winning run in the Premier League, the role of Enzo Fernandez was masked by victories. Now that City have suffered consecutive losses to Brighton and Aston Villa, you do wonder if Maresca has a blind spot in regards to Enzo Fernandez. The Manchester City midfield against Brighton was disjointed until changes were made. Enzo Maresca started what looked to be the ideal Manchester City midfield mix against Brighton. Ayyoub Bouaddi, Enzo Fernandez and Elliot Anderson started in midfield. The expectation was that the trio would have the ability to control the midfield battle against Fabian Hurzeler’s side. However, that didn’t occur in the 55 minutes that the trio played as City were beaten 1-0 by Brighton . Elliot Anderson did what he does best against Brighton. The England international was all over the pitch and he was easily Manchester City’s man-of-the-match against Brighton. However, the issue was that Ayyoub Bouaddi and Enzo Fernandez looked to be playing in roles that didn’t suit them. Bouaddi was more advanced in midfield and was also tasked with leading Manchester City’s press with Erling Haaland. This role didn’t suit him. Enzo Fernandez sat deeper in midfield and failed to impact Saturday’s match. You do wonder what the thought process was with Bouaddi and Enzo Fernandez playing the roles they did against Brighton. The roles that both players played didn’t suit them. That was to City’s detriment until Ayyoub Bouaddi was replaced by Rayan Cherki in the 55th minute. Enzo Fernandez was replaced by Nico O’Reilly in the 64th minute. It did seem like Bouaddi was playing in an advanced midfield role to cover the issues in Enzo Fernandez’s game out of possession. If that was the case, it highlights a potential issue with the constant selection of Enzo Fernandez at this stage. Far too often it has been Rayan Cherki who has been sacrificed or Ayyoub Bouaddi over Enzo Fernandez. item.title: Manchester United are in the race to sign La Liga midfielder
item.description: Manchester United are in the race to sign La Liga midfielder Manchester United Enquire About Pablo Barrios as PSG Push Builds Around Atletico Madrid Midfielder Manchester United have made an enquiry over Atletico Madrid midfielder Pablo Barrios, with TeamTalk reporting that the Premier League club are among several major European sides tracking his situation ahead of future transfer windows. The 23-year-old has developed into one of the most closely watched midfielders in Europe and, according to the report, United’s interest is currently at an early point. It is described as being “at an exploratory stage, with no formal negotiations underway”, which fits the wider picture of a club assessing multiple midfield options before taking any firm action. Barrios has earned four senior Spain caps and become a trusted figure under Diego Simeone. His profile is easy to understand in the current market. He brings defensive assurance, tactical discipline and enough attacking quality to suit elite-level midfield systems. Those traits, combined with his age and growing experience, have naturally elevated him into a serious transfer discussion. Manchester United tracking Pablo Barrios closely United are understood to have stepped up background checks during their recent Champions League trip to Madrid. That visit offered another reminder of Barrios’ quality, especially after he “score against them after just 49 seconds of their recent encounter, which Atleti won 2-0.” It was the kind of contribution that reinforces why recruitment departments continue to revisit his name. There is no suggestion of advanced talks at this stage, but the fact United have already asked questions matters. item.title: RSC Anderlecht: Purple, pop culture and a park
item.description: RSC Anderlecht: Purple, pop culture and a park Opposition analysis This Thursday 5 November our Red Bulls face one of the most exciting away trips on their UEFA Europa League fixture list. With 34 league titles and several European trophies to their name, Royal Sporting Club Anderlecht are not only the undisputed biggest name in Belgian football. The club also embodies, perhaps more than any other in Europe, a unique balance between a regal footballing past and an avant-garde present. 1908 year of foundation Between red brick and floodlights The match will take place at Lotto Park - a venue still known to many European football romantics by its historic name, the Constant Vanden Stock Stadium. Located in the heart of the lush Astrid Park in the Brussels suburb of Anderlecht, the arena has a capacity of approximately 21,500 spectators. What makes this place so special is its deep connection to the surrounding neighbourhood. The stands are positioned so close to the surrounding terraced houses that one corner of the stadium even had to be cut off diagonally to avoid obstructing the street. 106 Million Euro estimated market value On match days, the area around the stadium is filled with the scent of classic Belgian fries and light-coloured beer. In the neighborhood’s long-established pubs, portraits of legends - such as Henri Meert, Jan Mulder and homegrown talent Romelu Lukaku - hang on the walls. Jerseys from a pop star, football as haute couture The fact that the Mauves et Blancs (Purples and Whites) place great importance on their appearance has always been part of the club's identity. In recent years, the club has partnered with the Brussels-based fashion label Mosaert - a venture spearheaded by none other than global superstar Stromae , alongside designer Coralie Barbier and Luc Van Haver. Together, the collective gave the team’s kits and overall visual identity an elegant makeover, and they even produced a remix of the club anthem. On the banks of the canal Our team are heading to a capital defined by fascinating contrasts. On one side lies Brussels’ glamorous city center, home to the magnificent Grand Place, the royal galleries, and the world of international diplomacy. On the other side, west of the canal, pulses the authentic, gritty heart of Anderlecht, where the club remains deeply rooted in the daily life of the neighbourhood. On Thursday, it will be crucial for our boys to prevent the hosts from finding their rhythm on the pitch and to proactively silence the intense atmosphere at Astrid Park by imposing our own dynamic style of play! Fans following from home can catch the action via a stream on Canal+ with the match starting at 18:45 CET.

After Saturday’s 3-1 loss to Milan, Inter’s first league defeat of the season and their eighth derby in a row without a win, Barella and Bastoni both said the squad’s mentality had to change. “I fully agree with what they said,” Thuram explained. “They’re two leaders, and their words were important.” MILAN, ITALY – OCTOBER 25: Marcus Thuram of FC Internazionale Milano celebrates scoring his team’s first goal during the Serie A match between FC Internazionale and ACF Fiorentina at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on October 25, 2026 in Milan, Italy. item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Donte DiVincenzo already believed his comeback was progressing well. Hearing his surgeon agree gave him something the workouts alone couldn’t provide. In a new video released by the Minnesota Timberwolves , DiVincenzo visits orthopedic surgeon Dr. Martin O’Malley for an assessment of his recovery from a torn right Achilles tendon. The conversation offers encouragement for a guard determined to play this season. “We can easily say you’re on schedule, if not certainly ahead of schedule with your strength and all your numbers,” O’Malley told him. The discussion then turns to returning to basketball. “When this happened, the goal was to be back for this season,” O’Malley said. “That’s not even a question.” Apr 23, 2026; Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA; Denver Nuggets guard Jamal Murray (27) works around Minnesota Timberwolves guard Donte DiVincenzo (0) in the first quarter at Target Center. O’Malley emphasizes that the decision involves DiVincenzo and the team, with particular importance placed on when the guard feels ready and normal again.
